title: To Sky Demon City
summary: Mo Lihai explains that Sky Demon Country, one of the nine demon countries, holds a Demon General Tournament every 300 years, and this time two Vice Commander-in-Chief seats are open after a war with Fire Demon Country. Wang Lin returns to the Soul Refining Tribe for two months, teaches Ouyang Hua the second half of the Soul Refining Technique, Soul Extraction, gives Shi San the next stage of the Giant Demon body-refining art, and leaves the damaged Holy Soul Flag behind to guard the tribe. Hu Pao is alive at the Demon Tower on the Ancient Battlefield, serving the Scattered Devil through the man who rescued him, while the Scattered Devil watches Wang Lin's progress. Wang Lin travels with Mo Lihai to Sky Demon City, where they meet the rival generals Shi Xiao and, by reputation, Mo Fei; Shi Xiao's companion is Chen Tao, a wounded fellow disciple of All-Seer, who warns him about the Da Lou Sword Sect. Wanting a place to kill freely to train his Slaughter Immortal Art, Wang Lin is sent by Mo Lihai into Hong Prison for seven days, where Xu Huichuan receives him.
events: Mo Lihai explains the Demon General Tournament and the two open Vice Commander-in-Chief seats
Wang Lin returns to the Soul Refining Tribe, teaching Soul Extraction to Ouyang Hua and body refining to Shi San
He leaves the Holy Soul Flag to protect the tribe and orders it to grow to a million members
Hu Pao serves the Scattered Devil at the Demon Tower on the Ancient Battlefield
Wang Lin questions the captive Yao Xixue about the Blood Soul Pill; she refuses
Wang Lin and Mo Lihai arrive in Sky Demon City and stay at the Mo residence
They meet Shi Xiao and Chen Tao, who warns about the Da Lou Sword Sect
Mo Lihai arranges for Wang Lin to enter Hong Prison to kill prisoners
cultivation: Shi Xiao: great perfection Soul Transformation. Xu Huichuan: great perfection Soul Transformation. Chen Tao is an Ascendant who hid his cultivation to enter, now wounded below Ascendant. Wang Lin is at the peak of Soul Transformation.

changes: Main source: AnimeKhor Indonesian fansub (ep116.id.srt) and its caption cards; the YouTube English track for this episode is machine-made and garbled, used only for cross-checks.
Place names follow the glossary (Sky Demon Country / Sky Demon City / Fire Demon Country); the fansub says Prefektur Tianyao / Kota Iblis Surgawi / Prefektur Huoyao.
Xu Huichuan uses the glossary spelling; his card reads Xu Sichuan.
Ming Yuan is named here from the glossary (Hu Pao's 'benefactor', debut EP116); he is only named on screen in EP122.
flags: Who calls Wang Lin 'my junior brother' (758s) is not clear; Wang Lin then thinks that Master (All-Seer) helped Chen Tao hide his Ascendant cultivation, so the speaker is taken to be Chen Tao.
Chen Tao is not in the glossary; pinyin from the fansub.
Wang Lin calls himself 'Wang Mo' (王某, 'I, Wang') in the fansub; not a name.
